lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec lists an explicit role set for a permission gate grep every place that gate is reused on the frontend not just the backend roles and confirm the role list matches exactly not an older adjacent gate
lessons.text: When a spec lists an explicit role set for a permission gate, grep every place that gate is reused on the frontend (not just the backend @Roles) and confirm the role list matches exactly, not an older adjacent gate.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a guard filters records that get merged into a keyed map test it by asserting the map result directly for the filtered case not only through a caller whose own key structure already excludes the filtered record by construction
lessons.text: When a guard filters records that get merged into a keyed map, test it by asserting the map/result directly for the filtered case, not only through a caller whose own key structure already excludes the filtered record by construction.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a spec s same validation as an existing field claim must be verified against that field s actual dto decorators not assumed isstring alone never rejects empty or whitespace only strings use isnotempty or a trim check when the spec requires non blank text
lessons.text: A spec's 'same validation as an existing field' claim must be verified against that field's actual DTO decorators, not assumed — @IsString() alone never rejects empty or whitespace-only strings; use @IsNotEmpty() or a trim check when the spec requires non-blank text.
evidence: Edge case: título vazio/só espaço / apps/api/src/celebrations/dto/create-song.dto.ts, create-setlist-song.dto.ts (api/dto)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when spec md leaves an operational detail pagination empty state retry behavior undefined for an ac capture the concrete decision explicitly in design md and treat it as the acceptance criterion for that round rather than leaving it implicit in the implementation
lessons.text: When spec.md leaves an operational detail (pagination, empty state, retry behavior) undefined for an AC, capture the concrete decision explicitly in design.md and treat it as the acceptance criterion for that round, rather than leaving it implicit in the implementation.
evidence: spec.md AC2 (P1: Conteúdos e Notificações) — pagination/empty-state/load-more not detailed in spec.md (mobile)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an implementation intentionally diverges from an ac s literal wording based on a backend finding update spec md s ac text to match the confirmed decision not just design md a reader of spec md alone should not be misled
lessons.text: When an implementation intentionally diverges from an AC's literal wording based on a backend finding, update spec.md's AC text to match the confirmed decision, not just design.md — a reader of spec.md alone should not be misled.
evidence: spec.md AC2 wording ('visíveis para os segmentos de audiência') vs. design.md finding (listing endpoint does not filter by segment) (mobile)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::crit rio de layout na spec precisa nomear o observ vel que o teste vai afirmar classe atributo ou limite porque jsdom n o mede layout renderizado
lessons.text: Critério de layout na spec precisa nomear o observável que o teste vai afirmar (classe, atributo ou limite), porque jsdom não mede layout renderizado
evidence: .specs/features/setlist-repertorio-conexao/validation.md — Edge Case 'título longo trunca sem quebrar o layout'; asserção em apps/web/src/components/repertorio/SongPicker.test.tsx:165 (apps/web)

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec ac lists multiple displayed fields e g nome hor rio respons vel verify each field is actually rendered in the component not just the ones covered by the design md data model a field present in the type but never read in jsx is a silent ac gap
lessons.text: When a spec AC lists multiple displayed fields (e.g. 'nome/horário/responsável'), verify each field is actually rendered in the component, not just the ones covered by the design.md data model — a field present in the type but never read in JSX is a silent AC gap.

lessons.key: ac_gap::every edge case listed in spec md needs its own dedicated test assertion even when the code path looks obviously correct by inspection evidence or zero treats an unasserted edge case as uncovered regardless of code quality
lessons.text: Every edge case listed in spec.md needs its own dedicated test assertion, even when the code path looks obviously correct by inspection — evidence-or-zero treats an unasserted edge case as uncovered regardless of code quality.

lessons.key: ac_gap::quando o ac ou design md exigem estado de erro com op o de tentar novamente implemente uma a o de retry execut vel onpress que refaz o fetch em toda tela de erro da feature e teste a n o s a mensagem de erro
lessons.text: Quando o AC ou design.md exigem estado de erro 'com opção de tentar novamente', implemente uma ação de retry executável (onPress que refaz o fetch) em toda tela de erro da feature, e teste-a — não só a mensagem de erro.

lessons.key: ac_gap::quando a tabela de assumptions j registra que nenhum write path existe para um campo remova ou mova pra out of scope qualquer ac edge case que declare shall sobre a escrita desse campo n o deixe as duas se es se contradizerem
lessons.text: Quando a tabela de Assumptions já registra que nenhum write path existe para um campo, remova ou mova pra Out of Scope qualquer AC/Edge Case que declare SHALL sobre a escrita desse campo — não deixe as duas seções se contradizerem.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::teste unit rio que mocka queryraw inteiro n o pega cl usula where errada ex exclus o de doador removida para sql de reten o exclus o sens vel adicione ao menos um teste de integra o contra o sql real ou asserte o texto da query
lessons.text: Teste unitário que mocka $queryRaw inteiro não pega cláusula WHERE errada (ex.: exclusão de doador removida) — para SQL de retenção/exclusão sensível, adicione ao menos um teste de integração contra o SQL real ou asserte o texto da query.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a task description contradicts an already registered architecture decision ad nnn implement and test the ad compliant behavior and record a spec deviation instead of forcing the task s literal wording
lessons.text: When a task description contradicts an already-registered architecture decision (AD-NNN), implement and test the AD-compliant behavior and record a SPEC_DEVIATION instead of forcing the task's literal wording.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an ac s outcome depends on an external provider s documented but unverifiable locally semantics e g a filter operator s behavior on absent values cite the provider doc in design md and flag the ac as a spec precision gap instead of writing a unit test that only re asserts the code s own logic
lessons.text: When an AC's outcome depends on an external provider's documented-but-unverifiable-locally semantics (e.g. a filter operator's behavior on absent values), cite the provider doc in design.md and flag the AC as a spec-precision gap instead of writing a unit test that only re-asserts the code's own logic.
